determinism_note: Historical exact BC used CPU, variant and mixed BC used MPS, seed3 and one CPU thread. Device/library differences can change fitted tensors; portable warmstart packaging and metadata/base-filename changes also change serialized checkpoint hashes. Binary-identical retraining across MPS/CPU versions is not guaranteed.
exact_case_alias_note: native-exact5-cases retains historic teacher IDs; exact5-cases defines identical physical fixtures under protocol IDs.

argv:
import hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path("lab/runs/uc2-repro")
paths=[root/"teacher-var100-shard0.jsonl",root/"teacher-var100-shard1.jsonl",root/"teacher-exact5-uc2-313.jsonl"]
output=root/"train-var100-exact5-replay4-v1.jsonl"
digest=hashlib.sha256()
with output.open("xb") as out:
    for source in paths:
        with source.open("rb") as incoming:
            for raw in incoming:
                if not raw.strip(): continue
                if source==paths[-1]:
                    row=json.loads(raw); row["weight"]=float(row.get("weight",1))*4; row["replay_multiplier"]=4.0; row["replay_source"]="native_exact5"
                    raw=(json.dumps(row,separators=(",",":"),allow_nan=False)+"\n").encode()
                out.write(raw); digest.update(raw)
manifest={"schema":"uc2-verified-teacher-mixture-v1","split":"train","dataset_sha256":digest.hexdigest(),"sources":[{"path":str(path)} for path in paths]}
output.with_suffix(".manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+"\n")
